The union of the Who's On First county records East Mamprusi (1108759917), Saboba/ Chereponi (1108759929), West Mamprusi (1108759937). Each member is assigned to the region that GeoNames files most of the populated places inside its boundary under, counted on 2026-11-26. The Saboba/Chereponi record (1108759929) spans the regional line: GeoNames files 41 of the 171 populated places inside it under Northern Region.
